name: Rukiel
source:
"You asked me to do something troublesome..."

He was praised for his exceptionally high intellect, and was selected as an Archangel at a young age. 

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110407061816fw_/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/anjel_s.html]official website[/url]]

Although he's well over 100 years old, he appears to only be around 23.
